scenario: Vendor invoices arriving in the shared ap@ Gmail inbox are read, matched to a vendor in QuickBooks, and labeled/forwarded to the cost-center approver listed in the vendor-owner sheet; invoices from unknown vendors are routed to the vendor-onboarding queue.
rule_hooks: vendor-to-approver mapping sheet

scenario: Newly entered bills in Xero awaiting approval are assigned to an approver by amount tier (manager under $5k, director under $25k, CFO above), and the assigned approver is pinged in Slack with the bill link.
rule_hooks: approval authority matrix by amount

scenario: Bills flagged by the AP system as failing PO/receipt/invoice match are triaged by exception type (price variance, quantity variance, missing receipt) and assigned to purchasing, the warehouse lead, or the requester in Asana.
rule_hooks: variance tolerance percentages per exception type

scenario: Monthly vendor statements emailed to AP are compared against open bills in QuickBooks, and each statement is tagged as reconciled, missing-invoice, or payment-not-applied, with a Zendesk ticket opened for the AP clerk owning that vendor alphabet range.
rule_hooks: clerk assignment by vendor name range

scenario: Emails requesting changes to vendor remittance bank details are flagged as high-risk, routed to the treasury verification queue, and the requester receives a templated reply saying a call-back verification to the number on file is required before any change.
rule_hooks: fraud-control callback policy

scenario: Freshdesk tickets from vendors asking 'when will I be paid' are answered by looking up the bill's status and scheduled payment date in Bill.com, and tickets for bills on hold are escalated to the AP supervisor.
rule_hooks: payment run calendar and hold reasons

scenario: Incoming invoices are checked against bills from the last 90 days for same vendor, amount, and invoice number or date; suspected duplicates are tagged in the AP tracker sheet and held, while clean ones proceed to approval.
rule_hooks: duplicate matching criteria and lookback window

scenario: New vendor setup form submissions are checked for an attached W-9 or W-8BEN; complete ones are routed to the master-data team in Jira, and incomplete ones trigger a reply to the requester listing missing documents and a 'pending docs' status in the vendor sheet.
rule_hooks: required onboarding documents by vendor type

scenario: Submitted expense reports in Expensify are routed to the employee's manager from the HRIS-exported org sheet, with reports containing out-of-policy items additionally routed to the finance controller.
rule_hooks: org chart and expense policy limits

scenario: Corporate card transactions in Ramp older than 7 days without a receipt are triaged by amount: under $75 auto-accepted per policy, above that the cardholder gets a Slack DM reminder, and repeat offenders past 30 days are escalated to their manager.
rule_hooks: receipt requirement threshold and aging tiers

scenario: Expense lines tagged as hotel, airfare, or meals are compared against the per-city per diem table; violations are commented on in the expense tool and assigned to the travel policy owner for review.
rule_hooks: per diem rates by city and category

scenario: Employee emails reporting unrecognized corporate card charges are logged in the card-ops sheet, the card is flagged for freeze in Brex when the amount exceeds $500, and the request is assigned to the card program admin.
rule_hooks: dispute amount threshold and freeze policy

scenario: Zendesk tickets from customers disputing an invoice are categorized (pricing error, service not delivered, duplicate charge) and routed to billing ops, account management, or the collections lead, with the related Salesforce account's owner added as a CC.
rule_hooks: dispute reason codes to owning team

scenario: Customer replies to automated dunning emails are read and sorted into promise-to-pay, dispute, already-paid, or request-for-copy; each updates the AR aging sheet's status column and is assigned to the collector owning that customer's region.
rule_hooks: collector territory assignments

scenario: Remittance advice emails from customers are parsed for invoice numbers and amounts, matched to open invoices in NetSuite, and unmatched or short-paid remittances are routed to the cash application specialist in Slack.
rule_hooks: short-pay tolerance and matching keys

scenario: Sales rep requests in a Slack channel to raise a customer's credit limit are checked against the customer's payment history and current exposure; requests within the analyst's authority are assigned to the credit analyst, larger ones to the credit manager.
rule_hooks: credit authority tiers and DSO history

scenario: Intercom conversations requesting refunds are matched to the Stripe charge, and refunds under $200 within 30 days are approved and replied to automatically while others are assigned to the billing manager with the charge details.
rule_hooks: refund policy by amount and age

scenario: Customer emails asking for invoice copies or W-9s are answered by locating the invoice PDF in QuickBooks and replying with the attachment, and requests for accounts on credit hold are routed to collections instead.
rule_hooks: credit-hold status lookup

scenario: Closed-won opportunities in HubSpot trigger billing setup requests that are triaged by contract type (subscription, usage, one-time) and assigned to the billing specialist for that product line in Monday.com.
rule_hooks: contract type to billing specialist map

scenario: Customers' emailed sales-tax exemption certificates are checked for state, expiration date, and signature; valid ones are logged in the exemption tracker and flagged for application in Avalara, while invalid ones get a reply listing the defect.
rule_hooks: state certificate validity requirements

scenario: Scanned tax-authority notices arriving in the tax@ mailbox are classified by jurisdiction and notice type (payroll, sales tax, income tax), logged with response deadlines in the tax calendar sheet, and assigned to the responsible tax preparer or outside advisor.
rule_hooks: jurisdiction ownership and response deadlines

scenario: January vendor emails questioning 1099 amounts are compared against payment totals in QuickBooks, mismatches are logged and routed to the tax accountant, and matching ones receive a reply with the payment breakdown.
rule_hooks: 1099 reportable payment rules

scenario: Manual journal entries submitted via a Google Form are routed for review based on amount and account type, with entries touching revenue or equity accounts requiring controller approval regardless of size.
rule_hooks: JE approval matrix by account class

scenario: Slack messages in the month-end close channel reporting a blocked close task are matched to the close checklist in Asana, the task is marked blocked, and the owner of the dependent task plus the assistant controller are notified based on the close calendar day.
rule_hooks: close calendar and task dependencies

scenario: Unmatched bank feed transactions in Xero older than 5 days are triaged by pattern (bank fees, merchant deposits, wires, unknown) and assigned to the staff accountant owning that bank account, with unknowns over $10k escalated to treasury.
rule_hooks: bank account ownership and aging/amount thresholds

scenario: Intercompany balance mismatch reports emailed after the subsidiary close are split by entity pair and assigned to the paired entity accountants in Jira, with mismatches above materiality copied to the group controller.
rule_hooks: entity pair owners and materiality threshold

scenario: Weekly department spend versus budget rows in the budget sheet are triaged, and departments over 90% of quarterly budget get a Slack notice to the budget owner while those over 105% are escalated to the FP&A lead and the VP.
rule_hooks: budget utilization thresholds

scenario: Budget transfer requests submitted through a form are validated against the remaining budget per line, routed to the FP&A partner for that department, and requests crossing department lines are additionally sent to the CFO.
rule_hooks: FP&A partner assignments and cross-department rule

scenario: Purchase requisitions created in Coupa are assigned to procurement buyers by spend category and require a competitive-bid flag when the total exceeds $50k; software requests are also routed to IT security.
rule_hooks: category buyer map and bid thresholds

scenario: Asset purchase requests are reviewed for capitalization eligibility (cost over $2,500 and useful life over one year); eligible items are tagged CapEx and routed to the fixed-asset accountant, others to the department's OpEx approver.
rule_hooks: capitalization policy threshold

scenario: Outbound wire requests posted in the treasury Slack channel are checked for required fields and dual approval; complete requests under $100k go to the treasury analyst, larger ones require the treasurer, and international wires are also routed for OFAC screening.
rule_hooks: wire limits and dual-control policy

scenario: Automated bank alert emails (low balance, positive pay exceptions, ACH returns) are categorized by alert type and account, logged in the treasury log, and routed to the responsible treasury owner with urgency set by same-day cutoff times.
rule_hooks: alert type urgency and bank cutoff times

scenario: Positive pay exception items reported by the bank are compared to the check register sheet; checks matching issued payee and amount are marked approve, while mismatches are flagged return and escalated to the controller before the decision deadline.
rule_hooks: check register and pay/return deadline

scenario: Prepared-by-client requests from external auditors in the audit request tracker are assigned to owners by account area (revenue, payroll, fixed assets, leases), with due dates set from the audit timeline and overdue items escalated to the controller.
rule_hooks: account area ownership and audit timeline

scenario: Control testers' reports of failed or deficient SOX control tests are logged in the controls register and assigned to the control owner, with deficiencies on key controls notified to internal audit and the CFO.
rule_hooks: key-control designation and deficiency severity

scenario: Employee helpdesk tickets about paycheck discrepancies are categorized (missing hours, deduction error, tax withholding) and routed to payroll operations or the benefits team, with tickets near the next payroll cutoff marked urgent.
rule_hooks: issue category owners and payroll cutoff

scenario: Signed contracts arriving from DocuSign are screened for nonstandard terms (multi-element, acceptance clauses, extended payment terms) and those with flags are routed to the revenue accountant for ASC 606 review while standard ones go straight to billing.
rule_hooks: nonstandard contract term checklist

scenario: Cancellation requests from the customer success Zendesk queue are checked against contract end dates in Salesforce, and early terminations are routed to the billing manager to apply termination fees while end-of-term ones are scheduled for non-renewal.
rule_hooks: contract terms and termination fee clauses

scenario: Renewal notices for office leases and insurance policies sent to the finance mailbox are logged with renewal dates in the contract tracker, assigned to the owner responsible for that contract type, and flagged urgent if the notice window is under 60 days.
rule_hooks: contract owner map and notice windows

scenario: Monthly state-level sales totals from the sales report are compared against economic nexus thresholds, and states approaching or crossing the threshold trigger a Slack alert and a registration task assigned to the tax manager.
rule_hooks: state economic nexus thresholds

scenario: New-vendor setup requests submitted via a Typeform intake are read for vendor type, country, spend estimate and category, then routed in the vendor master tracker to procurement, tax or compliance review, with the requester notified in Slack of the review path.
rule_hooks: vendor-type review matrix, high-risk category list

scenario: Daily OFAC/denied-party screening results posted to a shared inbox are matched to vendors and payees in the ERP; true-match candidates get their payments placed on hold and are escalated to compliance, while known false positives are cleared and logged.
rule_hooks: match score bands, cleared-entity whitelist

scenario: Invoices from non-US vendors arriving in the AP inbox are checked against the vendor's W-8 form on file and the payment type, then tagged with the treaty withholding rate in QuickBooks or routed to the tax team when no valid form or treaty basis exists.
rule_hooks: treaty rate table, W-8 form validity

scenario: Approved invoices in the payables queue are scanned for early-payment terms such as 2/10 net 30, and those whose discount window closes before the next scheduled pay run are flagged and moved into an off-cycle payment batch for treasury approval.
rule_hooks: discount terms, pay-run calendar, minimum discount value

scenario: Emails from suppliers asking to be paid ahead of terms are matched to their open invoices, then routed to treasury for supply-chain-finance enrollment, approved at a discount, or declined with a templated reply based on the supplier's tier.
rule_hooks: supplier tier list, early-pay discount schedule

scenario: Credit memos received from vendors are matched to open bills in Xero and applied to the oldest eligible invoice; unmatched or expired credits are routed to the AP specialist with a request to obtain a cash refund.
rule_hooks: credit expiry dates, application order policy

scenario: Vendor emails announcing price increases are compared against the contract terms in the contract tracker sheet, and increases above the contractual cap or without required notice are routed to procurement while compliant ones are forwarded to the budget owner.
rule_hooks: contract price-escalation caps, notice periods

scenario: Software renewal notices from vendors are logged with renewal date, amount and cancellation deadline, then assigned to the owning budget holder in Asana with a due date ahead of the notice deadline; renewals above a threshold also notify the FP&A partner.
rule_hooks: notice-period deadlines, renewal value thresholds

scenario: Corporate card transactions coded to software are checked against the approved-application register, and charges for unregistered tools are routed to IT security and procurement with a Slack message to the cardholder asking for business justification.
rule_hooks: approved app register, merchant category codes

scenario: Carrier invoices are compared with the rate card and the shipment records; invoices carrying unapproved accessorial charges such as detention or liftgate fees are disputed with the carrier, while in-tolerance invoices are released to the AP approver.
rule_hooks: carrier rate cards, accessorial approval list, variance tolerance

scenario: Monthly utility bills for each office and warehouse site are compared against the trailing-average usage in a tracking sheet; bills with abnormal spikes go to the facilities manager for review before payment, and normal bills are coded and approved.
rule_hooks: site baseline usage, percent-variance threshold

scenario: Payable invoices denominated in non-functional currencies are identified and routed to treasury for payment-method and FX-rate handling; invoices above the hedging threshold are added to the weekly FX exposure sheet.
rule_hooks: currency list, hedging threshold, payment rail by country

scenario: Vendor and employee requests to reissue lost or expired checks are matched to the check register; checks that are still outstanding get a stop-payment request and are queued for reissue, while checks already cleared trigger a reply with the clearing image.
rule_hooks: check status, stale-date policy, stop-payment fee rules

scenario: Outstanding checks and customer credit balances that are approaching each state's dormancy period are pulled from the aging report, owner letters are sent by email, and items with no response are routed to the escheat filing tracker.
rule_hooks: state dormancy periods, due-diligence letter windows

scenario: Stripe chargeback notifications for customer payments are read for reason code and amount, then assigned in the helpdesk to the AR rep who owns the account, with evidence deadlines set; disputes below the minimum value are auto-accepted.
rule_hooks: reason code playbook, minimum contest amount

scenario: Failed subscription payment events are triaged by decline code: soft declines get a scheduled retry, expired cards trigger a card-update email to the customer, and repeated failures on high-value accounts are escalated to the customer success manager in HubSpot.
rule_hooks: decline code categories, retry schedule, account value tiers

scenario: Unapplied cash receipts sitting in the AR suspense account are assigned to the collector who owns each customer in Salesforce, prioritized by amount and age, with a weekly Slack digest of the items still unresolved.
rule_hooks: customer-owner mapping, aging buckets

scenario: Customer accounts carrying credit balances from overpayments are reviewed; credits are applied to open invoices when available, refunded when the customer has no open invoices and requests it, or routed to the AR lead when the credit exceeds a threshold.
rule_hooks: credit balance thresholds, apply-vs-refund policy

scenario: Customer emails requesting installment plans on past-due balances are matched to their aging; plans within standard limits are approved with a templated schedule, and larger balances or customers with a broken plan history go to the credit manager.
rule_hooks: max plan length and balance, payment-plan history

scenario: Sales reps' Slack requests to release a customer order from credit hold are checked against the customer's past-due balance and credit limit, then auto-released, approved by the credit manager, or denied with the outstanding amount stated.
rule_hooks: past-due tolerance, credit limit headroom, approval authority

scenario: AR requests to write off residual short-pays and small uncollectable balances are batched; balances under the auto-approval amount are written off in QuickBooks, and larger amounts are routed to the controller with the collection history attached.
rule_hooks: write-off authority limits, reason codes

scenario: Rejection emails from customers' AP departments citing a missing or invalid PO number are logged against the invoice, assigned to the account manager to obtain the PO, and the invoice is reissued in the billing system once the PO is supplied.
rule_hooks: customer PO requirement flags, rejection reasons

scenario: Invoice rejections from customer procurement portals such as Coupa and Ariba are parsed for the rejection reason and routed accordingly: tax and format errors go to billing for resubmission, and pricing or quantity mismatches go to the account owner.
rule_hooks: portal rejection codes, ownership by reason

scenario: Inbound customer requests for our company's W-9, certificate of insurance, bank verification letter or supplier forms are identified and answered from the document library when standard, or routed to tax, risk or treasury when a custom form or signature is needed.
rule_hooks: standard document library, signature authority

scenario: Project managers' Slack posts and Jira status changes marking deliverables complete are matched to billable milestones in the contract schedule, and draft invoices are created for billing review; milestones that require customer acceptance are held until sign-off is received.
rule_hooks: contract milestone schedule, acceptance requirements

scenario: Draft usage-based invoices for the month are compared with each customer's trailing usage before sending; spikes or drops beyond the threshold are held and routed to the account's CSM to confirm, and normal invoices are released.
rule_hooks: usage variance thresholds, account owner mapping

scenario: Salesforce opportunities submitted with nonstandard discounts or payment terms are routed through the finance approval chain based on discount percentage, deal size and term length, and the rep is notified in Slack of the decision.
rule_hooks: discount approval matrix, standard terms

scenario: Sales reps' tickets disputing commission statements are matched to their comp plan and the deals credited for the period, then assigned to the commission analyst for that plan, with disputes involving split credits escalated to sales ops.
rule_hooks: comp plan assignments, split-credit rules

scenario: Department heads' emailed accrual requests for unbilled services are logged in the accrual tracker; requests above the materiality threshold are assigned to the GL accountant for that entity to book, and smaller ones are rejected with a note explaining the policy.
rule_hooks: accrual materiality threshold, entity owner mapping

scenario: Incoming invoices covering multi-month service periods, such as annual subscriptions or maintenance contracts, are flagged for prepaid treatment, coded to the prepaid account, and added to the amortization schedule when they exceed the capitalization threshold.
rule_hooks: prepaid threshold, service period length

scenario: Requests from budget owners to move posted expenses to a different cost center or GL account are checked against period status and account permissions, then turned into reclass entries in the open period or routed to the controller when the period is closed.
rule_hooks: period lock status, chart-of-accounts restrictions

scenario: Requests to create, rename or deactivate GL accounts, departments or cost centers are routed to the controller for approval; deactivation requests for accounts with open balances or active budgets are bounced back to the requester.
rule_hooks: chart-of-accounts governance, account balance checks

scenario: Asset retirement and disposal forms from IT and facilities are matched to the fixed asset register; disposals are routed for approval based on net book value, and approved disposals are scheduled for a write-off entry.
rule_hooks: net book value thresholds, disposal method

scenario: Cycle count variance reports from the warehouse are reviewed by SKU; adjustments under the tolerance are posted automatically, and larger shrink or overage variances are routed to the cost accountant and the warehouse manager for investigation before posting.
rule_hooks: value and percent tolerances, SKU class

scenario: Court garnishment and child-support withholding orders arriving by mail scan or email are matched to employees in the HRIS, logged with their response deadlines, and assigned to payroll; orders for former employees trigger a termination-notice reply to the issuing agency.
rule_hooks: order type priority, response deadlines, employment status

scenario: Real and personal property tax bills for each location are logged with assessed value and due date, compared to the prior year, and routed to the tax manager for an appeal decision when the increase exceeds the threshold; all other bills go to AP for payment.
rule_hooks: year-over-year increase threshold, installment due dates

scenario: City, county and state business license and annual report renewal notices are matched to the entity and jurisdiction register, assigned to the responsible tax or legal owner with the filing deadline, and paid directly when the fee is fixed and under the limit.
rule_hooks: entity-jurisdiction register, filing deadlines

scenario: Invoices from EU and UK suppliers are checked for the required VAT elements, such as the supplier VAT ID, our VAT ID and a reverse-charge notation; noncompliant invoices are returned to the supplier with the missing fields listed, and compliant ones are coded for VAT reclaim.
rule_hooks: VAT invoice requirements by country, reverse-charge rules

scenario: Lender emails requesting quarterly compliance certificates and financial deliverables are logged with their due dates from the credit agreement, assigned to treasury and FP&A, and escalated to the CFO if the covenant ratios in the model sheet are near their limits.
rule_hooks: credit agreement deliverable schedule, covenant headroom

scenario: Broker and bank notices of maturing T-bills, CDs and money-market sweeps are matched to the investment ledger, and reinvestment instructions are drafted per the investment policy, or routed to the treasurer when the 13-week cash forecast shows a liquidity need.
rule_hooks: investment policy limits, cash forecast minimums
